change: Roll the seven upper day cards around the local current date while keeping the lower timeline on its existing rolling time window.

header.range: Three previous local civil days, today in slot index 3, three following local civil days.
header.dateArithmetic: Uses Date.setDate through addDays; no millisecond/24-hour arithmetic to select header dates.
header.intraday: Header dates and card positions stay fixed for the local civil day; they update on the next normal widget render after local midnight, subject to iOS scheduling.

alignment.weekdayRules: No special Saturday/Sunday alignment offsets. Actual weekday and holiday semantics still drive content and color.

timelineAndFrame.timeline: Existing lower 24-hour viewport continues to follow render time and is not recentered with the header.
timelineAndFrame.outline: One continuous white outline follows the centered today card and the moving timeline segment for today.
timelineAndFrame.curves: Existing common-radius/approved-gap neighbor geometry retained; next chronological slot controls the adjacent lower-left cusp.

preserved.weathergraphRoute: weathergraph://, supplied and confirmed by the user; launch needs Weathergraph installed.
preserved.touchRefresh: Disabled; no refresh action was added.
preserved.other: Existing blur, temperatures, charts, colors, fonts, event/reminder data, native storage, and timeline geometry remain.

validation.build: npm run build:scripting passed: 11 modules compiled/imported; native iOS types remain pending device validation.

centeredDates.coverage: 23:59 to 00:00, both DST transition dates, month/year changes, stable card geometry, independent timeline progression.

headerLayout.coverage: Weekdays, weekend colors, holidays, date widths, missing/negative temperatures, and seven display sizes.

validation.nativeIOS: No physical iPhone or iPad test was run. Synthetic Canvas tests do not verify native font substitution, operating-system launch registration, or exact WidgetKit refresh timing.

preview.description: Synthetic before/after comparison for Tuesday, Saturday/month change, Sunday/DST transition, and New Year. Barlow Condensed and DejaVu Mono substitute for native iOS font faces.

publication.note: This repository branch has an Android workflow only; no Scripting CI is configured.
